title: Metering and Interval Data Schedule for Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Metering and Interval Data Schedule

Schedule of the metering figures that attach to each tier of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions. Every figure below is fixed by the tier a building's subscription is written at; the subscription record names the tier in full.

## Included metering and data collection

| Tier | Interval meters included | Minimum interval meters the site must carry | Data collection interval (minutes) | Interval data kept available (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Utility Bill Tracking Subscription | 0 | 0 | 0 | 24 |
| Metering & Dashboard Subscription | 6 | 2 | 15 | 36 |
| Energy Analytics Subscription | 12 | 4 | 15 | 48 |
| Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription | 20 | 6 | 5 | 60 |
| Measurement & Verification Program | 30 | 8 | 5 | 84 |
| Managed Energy Performance Program | 60 | 12 | 1 | 120 |


A collection interval of 0 minutes on the Utility Bill Tracking Subscription means that tier collects no interval data at all: its readings come from the utility bill alone. Every other tier reads its meters at the stated interval and keeps the interval record available to the customer for the stated number of calendar months.

## Meter kinds each tier reads

| Meter kind | Utility Bill Tracking Subscription | Metering & Dashboard Subscription | Energy Analytics Subscription | Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription | Measurement & Verification Program | Managed Energy Performance Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Utility revenue meter | read | read | read | read | read | read |
| Electric submeter | not read | read | read | read | read | read |
| Gas submeter | not read | read | read | read | read | read |
| Water submeter | not read | not read | read | read | read | read |
| BTU meter | not read | not read | read | read | read | read |
| Point derived from the automation system | not read | read | read | read | read | read |

## Per-meter charges attached to the tier

| Tier | Annual fee per metered point beyond the included meters (USD per meter per year) | Fee per interval meter installed at the site (USD per meter) | Annual fee for the site data gateway (USD per year) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Utility Bill Tracking Subscription | 180 | 0 | 0 |
| Metering & Dashboard Subscription | 165 | 850 | 540 |
| Energy Analytics Subscription | 150 | 850 | 540 |
| Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription | 140 | 795 | 480 |
| Measurement & Verification Program | 130 | 750 | 480 |
| Managed Energy Performance Program | 115 | 695 | 0 |


### Reading the schedule

- The meter overage figure is an annual amount per point, charged only on points beyond the tier's included count; a Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription covering 20 points or fewer carries none of it.
- The installation figure is a one-time amount per interval meter the company installs; the Utility Bill Tracking Subscription installs no meters and the figure is 0.
- The gateway figure is an annual amount for the site's data gateway; on the Utility Bill Tracking Subscription and the Managed Energy Performance Program it is 0.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A building written at the Energy Analytics Subscription has 12 interval meters included, must carry at least 4, is read every 15 minutes, keeps 48 months of interval data, and carries USD 150 a year for each point beyond 12, USD 850 for each meter installed and USD 540 a year for the gateway.
